name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:* (wildcard service segment) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression: arn:aws:* wildcards the SERVICE segment, so the Resource matches essentially every ARN in the partition. A bulk read granted on it is account-wide. Previously resourceIsBroad() saw only the bare '*' as broad and this returned CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). DATA-EXFIL must fire; CLI must exit non-zero.
